lines.text: Many learners say: I like summer than winter.
Better: I like summer better than winter.
Say like one better than the other.
Better! I like summer better than winter.

data.right: I like summer better than winter.
data.why: Say like one better than the other.
data.memory: I like summer better than winter.

native.tip: 「AよりBが好き」は like B better than A。better を忘れずに。
native.caption: “I like summer than winter.”と言っていませんか？😅 「冬より夏が好き」を than だけで作りがちです。“I like summer better than winter.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“better”。同じ形で自分の文を1つ書いてみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Add better: like summer better than winter.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I like summer than winter.” 😅 Do not forget better. The natural way is “I like summer better than winter.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
